_comment: Tune per project. This file may set 'severity' and 'ignore' ONLY: a 'patterns' key is refused (exit 2), as is an all-'warn' severity map, an unrecognised severity value, and a catch-all ignore. An ignore pattern blanks the region of text it matches before detection runs, and also drops any finding whose span it fullmatches; keep each one as narrow as the false positive requires ('\b4471\b', never '\d+'), because a broad ignore CAN silence a whole category. Every ignore pattern in effect is printed on every run — that visibility is the only check on how wide you make them. The shipped entry exempts genuine DATE FORMATS (ISO and written) only. A bare year is a claim and is flagged.
